name: Summarise a delivery note
system: You turn a courier's or warehouse's note about an order from Larkfield, an online home and garden shop, into one sentence for the customer's order page. At most 25 words. Say what has happened or will happen, and what the customer has to do, if anything. Reply with the sentence only.
label: Orders
heading: The courier's note on your order

cases.input: Parcel collected from the Larkfield warehouse this morning and loaded for the overnight trunk to the Leeds depot. It will go out for delivery from there on Thursday between 8 am and 6 pm. No signature is needed.
Delivered at 14:12 today. The driver left the parcel in the porch as the delivery instructions asked, and took a photo, which is attached to the order.
Your order has been split. The two armchairs leave the warehouse today and should arrive on Monday. The footstool is out of stock and will follow in a second parcel, with no extra delivery charge.
The driver delivered the parcel to your neighbour at number 14 at 11:40, because nobody answered at your address. A card was put through your door to say so.
The parcel reached the Bristol depot at 05:30 and is on the van for delivery today. The driver's round usually reaches your postcode between 1 pm and 3 pm.
Your table was delivered by our two-person team at 10:05 and carried to the dining room. The team took the packaging away for recycling. The legs were fitted on site.
We have received the item you sent back. It arrived at the returns centre on Wednesday and passed inspection. Your refund has been sent and takes 3 to 5 working days to reach your card.
Your delivery was booked for Tuesday 17 November. The van has broken down and the round is cancelled. We have rebooked you for Thursday 19 November, same time slot, 8 am to 12 noon.
The parcel missed the sorting cut-off at the hub last night, so it will not arrive today, Friday, as planned. It is now due on Monday.
Storm warnings have closed the ferry route. Deliveries to the island planned for Wednesday will now go on the first sailing on Friday, weather allowing.
The mattress you ordered was due from the maker on 12 November but they have told us it will reach our warehouse on 20 November. We will deliver it to you on 23 November.
Sorry, we gave you the wrong date. Your order is not coming tomorrow. The driver's round for your area is on Saturday, so it will be with you on Saturday morning.
Customs held the parcel for two days for a routine check. It was released this afternoon. Delivery moves from Monday to Wednesday.
The driver tried to deliver at 9:15 and nobody was in. The parcel has gone back to the depot. Please book a new delivery day on the tracking page within 5 days, or it will be returned to Larkfield.
Your parcel is waiting at the Corner Stores pickup point on Mill Lane. Bring the collection code from your email and photo ID. It will be held until Friday 20 November.
We could not find your address. The label says 12 Meadow Way but the driver found no number 12 on that road. Please reply with the right house number or a nearby landmark so we can try again.

The sofa is too big for the standard van. A larger vehicle is needed and there must be someone at home to show the team in. Please phone the delivery team on the number in your order email to pick a day.
One of the two boxes arrived at the depot damaged and we have not sent it out. The other box will be delivered tomorrow. Tell us whether you want the damaged item replaced or refunded.
Your parcel needs a signature from someone aged 18 or over, because it contains garden tools with blades. Please make sure an adult is at home on Tuesday between 10 am and 2 pm.
